ambiguity.detail: Father Thomas's exact compromise and relationship to Catherine are built on implied backstory.

verdict.hook_line: Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A corrupt or compromised priest is blackmailed or bribed into spying on a high-stakes council hearing.
verdict.why_it_works: Ending on a dangerous ultimatum involving a powerful Duke creates an irresistible narrative cliffhanger.
